ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:4 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white mottled region on the left lobe (middle-to-distal section); smaller white patch on distal right lobe; pervasive high-intensity speckling across the dark-pigmented surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate aperture of 125 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations and jagged indentations across the entire trailing edge boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve transitioning from convex near the notch to concave towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial distribution of small, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters across the central and distal ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal linear disruptions with yellowish-brown pixel values observed on the lower-left ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jaggedness and tissue loss along the trailing edge indicative of historical mechanical trauma; yellowish-brown staining streaks on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of pervasive high-contrast speckling and localized yellowish-brown discoloration on the left lobe ventral surface.
